title: Tribe Treasury, Tribe Boss & Emblems
message:
Tribes level 3+ get a shared **Treasury**: deposit money or gems (it can't be withdrawn), then officers propose upgrades and members vote. Buy boosts, member slots, a War Banner (+10% tribe XP), extra contract rerolls and more.

Tribes level 10+ face a **Tribe Boss** every week: hunt, kill mythics and finish quests to damage it, and everyone who helps gets a crate.

Pick a tribe **emblem and banner colour** from the new Emblems tab in `/tribe`.

Also: daily and weekly leaderboards now count everything you earn since the period started, and every update now has a version number (YY.MM.DD.N) in `/update`.

title: Mythic fights are MUCH harder
message:
Spamming Kick or Punch will no longer win you a mythic fight, and Shoot is no longer a guaranteed win.

- Mythic creatures have far more HP and hit more accurately
- A **missed Kick now costs you HP**, and you're more likely to fall and eat a free hit
- **Shooting** leaves you exposed to its counterattack, and volleys miss more often
- **Defend** only heals the first 3 times in a fight, so you can't stall
- Cornered mythics (under 30% HP) hit harder
- Losing costs more cash and fleeing is less reliable

Arrive with full HP, bring healing, and pick your moments.

title: New setting: Hunt messages
message:
Choose how the **Hunt** button behaves in `/settings` → **New Message Per Hunt**.

- **OFF** (default): Hunt updates the same message in place
- **ON**: every Hunt posts a fresh message and keeps the old ones, so you can scroll back through your catches

`/hunt` always posts a new message.

title: Mythic art + Shard Charm
message:
- **Mythic fights** now show the creature's art big in the top right of the fight and result screens
- **Crate Charm** is now **Shard Charm** — it only ever boosted shard drops, so the name finally says so. Your upgrades carried over
- New `/giveaway` command group: giveaways, loot drops, number guesses and hunt races — watch your server for them
